$comment: PLTF-02 deliverable 15 — the committed substitution map that derives every recorded HTTP body
under test/fixtures/http/ from its byte-verbatim source in schemas/openapi/examples/**.
the PRD's example bodies carry PLACEHOLDER ids ('ans_...', 'job_...'), which no client could
ever receive. Recording a concrete body by hand would let it drift from the document silently.
Instead the concrete body is DERIVED, and test/fixtures/drift.test.ts re-derives it on every run
and asserts byte equality — so an OpenAPI example change fails this package's suite loudly
instead of leaving a vacuous replay behind.
job_/ans_/rec_ reuse FND-05's committed values verbatim, so a job id is the SAME string in this
package's SSE transcripts and in packages/contracts' signing fixtures.
Every value is an opaque PRD §34.1 identifier or a fabricated example URL. NOT A CREDENTIAL:
nothing here authorises anything, and no deployment may use these values.
